name: Tiger 1
subtitle: Dribble at the wing, backdoor cut
goal: Punish a defender who denies the wing: dribble at them and cut behind.
options: Best: 2 on the backdoor. Next: 5 curling down the lane, then 4 at the elbow for the jump shot.

steps.note: 1 dribbles at 2 and stops at the foul line extended. 2 cuts backdoor to the rim.
1 looks for 2. Not there? All at once: 2 clears out to the far wing, 3 fills the top, and 4 sets a screen away for 5.
5 curls off the screen and down the right side of the lane, looking for the pass inside.
4 returns to the elbow for a pass and the elbow jump shot. 5 goes back to the other elbow. We are back in our starting spots and can reverse it from here.
